summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Phase 1 MVP seeker navigation and dashboard refactoring. All critical features verified working correctly. Seeker sidebar shows correct 8 items (Dashboard, Find Jobs, My Profile, Licenses, Documents, Matches, Offers, Settings). Forbidden items (References, Connections, Passed, Saved Jobs, Feed, Interviews, Credentials) correctly removed. Dashboard stats row shows Profile %, Documents, Matches, Offers. Quick actions include Find Jobs, Upload License, Upload Documents, Complete Profile. MatchesPage TDZ bug fixed - page loads without errors. SwipePage heading correctly shows 'Find Jobs' for seekers. Offers page accessible at /seeker/offers. Employer sidebar still works correctly with Applicants submenu.
